plain_prompt: Describe visible {target} in this {modality} image in one short phrase, at most 12 English words. Start with '{prefix}'. State only visible appearance and broad image location. If uncertain, say uncertain. Do not infer a diagnosis or provide treatment.
structured_prompt: Identify up to three spatially separate image regions containing visible {target} in this {modality} image. Return only one valid JSON object, without Markdown or other text. The object must have the field regions, a list of region objects. Each region object must contain id (unique integer), description (a concise phrase describing image-specific visible evidence in that region, not instructions or placeholders), and box (four numbers in order x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max). The displayed image is [[IMAGE_WIDTH]] pixels wide and [[IMAGE_HEIGHT]] pixels high. Use absolute pixel coordinates in this displayed image, not normalized coordinates; x increases left to right, y increases top to bottom. Draw the tightest reasonable box around each visible target region; avoid overlapping or whole-image boxes unless truly necessary. If no target region can be identified, regions must be an empty list. Do not infer diagnoses.
